query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM idempotency i WHERE i.conversation_id=$1 AND (i.execution_status='sending' OR (i.execution_status='delivered' AND i.updated_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(secs => $2) AND i.updated_at > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(e.created_at) FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id=$1 AND e.lifecycle IS NOT NULL), '-infinity'::timestamptz) AND COALESCE((SELECT e.lifecycle FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id=$1 AND e.lifecycle IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.seq DESC LIMIT 1), '') NOT IN ('run.started', 'run.resumed')))) AS "in_flight!"
